title: eval-author — input requirements and output payload
description: Spec: REPO-DESIGN.md §5.3.3 (evals first). Files: stories/<slug>/tests/sample-event.json, stories/<slug>/tests/cases/<eval_id>.json, stories/<slug>/tests/expectations.yaml and storyline/work/<slug>/evals/cases.yaml (shape: storyline/templates/eval-cases.yaml). Every acceptance criterion maps to at least one case; at least one case has should_trigger: false. Payloads use documentation-range IPs (192.0.2.0/24, 198.51.100.0/24, 203.0.113.0/24) and *.example.invalid addresses only. The readiness gate G1 re-checks coverage from the files; this payload is the author's own account of it.

negative_cases.description: Ids of the should-not cases (should_trigger: false); a suite without one fails G1

model_graded_cases.description: Ids of the model_graded cases; each carries a rubric, a reference_output and k in cases.yaml. Empty for a story without an AI Agent action

gaps.description: Criteria that cannot be tested as written (not observable in a run's events, logs or result fields); each gap is a reason to send the design back, never a reason to skip a case

output.description: What ./scripts/storyline apply validates the baton's `payload` against: the full payload ($defs.payload) when the baton verdict is done or changes_requested, or an empty object when it is needs_human or blocked (baton.schema.json enforces which verdict allows which).
